_source: Real game lines cited <log>:<line>: 25 = the 2026-10-25 game log, 26 = the 2026-10-26 game log (Genie client logs). Each text is the timestamped copy of the line with its [hh:mm:ss AM] stamp removed, so no client substitution is in it. Read by ReplayGame.log (test/replay_game.rb); every log_lines.json under spec/fixtures shares one cite namespace.
